Location: 		Salisbury, QLD, 4107
Full-Time: 		Immediate start
Reports to: 		Manager
Job Title: 		Electrical Engineering Technician
Salary range: 		$79,500 - $86,600 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date:	30 Days

Position Overview: Mygration is engaged to source the following position for our client
Our client is a leading innovator in the design, fabrication, and installation of high-quality steel structures and electrical systems for industrial and commercial applications. With a strong focus on engineering excellence, safety, and precision, they deliver cutting-edge solutions across various sectors, including infrastructure, energy, and manufacturing.

We are seeking a skilled Electrical Engineering Technician to join their dynamic team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in supporting the design, installation, and maintenance of electrical systems for heavy machinery, substations, and industrial control systems. You will work closely with engineers and technologists to ensure all electrical installations meet industry standards, safety regulations, and project specifications.

This is an exciting opportunity for a detail-oriented professional with strong technical skills and a passion for electrical systems within an industrial and structural engineering environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design & Documentation:
• Prepare detailed electrical drawings, schematics, and layout plans for industrial installations, including substations, switchgear, motor control systems, and cabling networks.
• Develop wiring diagrams and termination schedules for control panels used in heavy machinery & manufacturing and automation systems.

Technical Support:
• Assist electrical engineers in the design, testing, and optimization of electrical systems for machinery & manufacturing and structural projects.
• Troubleshoot and diagnose faults in PLC-controlled systems, including servo drives and variable frequency drives (VFDs).

Testing & Analysis:
• Conduct electrical tests, perform complex calculations, and analyse data to validate system performance.
• Perform insulation resistance (IR) testing, earth continuity checks, and thermal imaging on high-voltage equipment.

Cost Estimation:
• Assist in estimating material quantities, costs, and project timelines.
• Evaluate supplier quotations for electrical components (e.g., circuit breakers, contactors) to ensure cost-effective procurement.

Quality Assurance:
• Inspect electrical installations and finished products for compliance with specifications.
• Verify that all electrical work adheres to AS/NZS 3000 and IEC standards before commissioning.

Installation & Maintenance:
• Assemble, install, calibrate, and repair electrical equipment, including protection relays and metering devices.
• Perform preventive maintenance on industrial motor control centres (MCCs) to minimize downtime.

Workshop Operations:
• Undertake workshop duties, including wiring, testing, and modifying electrical assemblies.
• Fabricate and test custom control panels for machinery integration.

Research & Development:
• Contribute to R&D initiatives by assisting in experimental programs.
• Assist in the testing and integration of renewable energy systems (e.g., solar inverters) into industrial power networks.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS:
• Trade Certification or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
• Proven experience in electrical drafting, machinery wiring, or industrial electrical systems and manufacturing fabrications.
• Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD Electrical) for schematic and layout design.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to perform technical calculations and interpret test data.
• Knowledge of industry standards, including AS/NZS 3000 and electrical safety regulations.
• Hands-on experience with motor controls, switchgear, PLCs, and protection systems is highly desirable.
• Workshop & fabrication skills, including the ability to assemble and troubleshoot electrical components.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and project teams.
• At least 2 years of Full-time on the job work experience.

WHY APPLY?
• Work with a forward-thinking company at the forefront of industrial and structural engineering.
• Engage in high-impact projects involving cutting-edge electrical systems.
• Opportunities for professional growth and skill development.
• Competitive remuneration and a supportive team environment.

If you are a motivated Electrical Engineering Technician with a passion for precision and innovation, we encourage you to apply! Submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

Please note: We are recruiting on behalf of our client. All applications will be treated with confidentiality.

About Upgrade Health

Upgrade Health employs dedicated allied health professionals from around the World, who focus on physiotherapy, occupational therapy, podiatry, speech pathology, psychology, remedial massage, and pilates.  We also specialise in occupational rehabilitation including workplace assessments, suitable duties programs, return to work plans and pre-employment assessments.

Commencing immediately.

Salary range: $80,000 - $110,000 + performance driven bonuses.

Reporting to the Director you will be responsible for providing our clients with care and taking accountability in their journey back to better health, while aligning yourself with our core Values; Care, Excellence, Collaboration, Growth.
Right now, Upgrade Health has a rare opportunity for an experienced Occupational Therapist to join our rapidly growing team.

As a qualified occupational therapist, you will assess, treat and prevent physical difficulties resulting from injury, illness, disability or ageing to improve movement and general wellbeing. In this role, you will have the opportunity to independently manage a varied caseload of NDIS Clients including Private Patients, DVA, Workcover & EPC Clients.

What we offer:
? An Employer/Employee Value Proposition like you never experienced
? Competitive salary and benefits package
? Ongoing professional learning and development including mentoring and coaching
? A diverse and inclusive work environment
? Career pathways and networking opportunities
? Organised 1:1’s, fortnightly teaching and journal clubs
? Fully equipped practices with pilates reformer, shock therapy, acupuncture, exercise physiology, massage therapy, computerised gait analysis, advanced posture screening software, OH&S training and rehabilitation, manual handling seminars

What you offer:
? Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Occupational Therapy
? AHPRA registration required
? At least 2 years’ experience as a registered Occupational Therapist with 1-year experience in private practice
? Understanding of the rights of people with a disability
? Current Valid Driver's License
?Current Working with Children Check or willingness to obtain one before commencement

Are you interested? Apply today.

Group Strategy Director (Also known as Group Strategy/Planning Director or Group Communications Planner/Director)
Trading Under Publicis Media Australia
Location: Sydney, Melbourne or Brisbane
The Group Strategy Director, alongside the Head of Strategy leads a team of strategists and is responsible for driving the strategic direction on behalf of a portfolio of clients or client. They are responsible for ensuring work meets the highest standards, locally and competitively within our global network.
•	Demonstrate leadership, commercial acumen and vision and inspire their team to deliver a cohesive, proactive approach to strategy which helps our clients grow.
•	Works closely with the client teams and the senior leadership team to ensure that the product delivered to clients is truly integrated and best in class.
•	Responsible for increasing the visibility of the Spark strategic product.
•	Accountable for financial performance, inclusive of revenue, client commercial agreements and team costs, encompassing long term planning for the team, reflective of client and team development needs.
•	Acts as a senior client escalation point, and trusted strategic advisor for key clients.
•	Works with the relevant Strategy Directors/ Account Directors/ Client Partners to guide them on the output of work that works for their clients and the optimal use of agency resource to achieve this. 
•	Develops and manages the Strategy Directors and broader agency team
•	Works with the Head of Strategy to define and deliver projects that enhance the output and efficiency of the team including managing resource in line with the ebb and flow of client work.
•	Recommend and recruit for new/ replacement roles to fit any changes to the client portfolio
•	Track head hour utilisation or the ream against the agreed remuneration for individual clients and agency projects
•	Acting as a trusted advisor to clients and internal stakeholders
•	Participation in agency new business
Experience required: Minimum 12 years industry experience, most recently in a similar position. Proven business acumen in medium to large agency. Possess an expert understanding of consumer psychology, behavioural economics, macro-economic influences,  trends and current marketing science thinking and an exceptional ability to make this actionable.
Salary – over threshold 
•	All of the above roles require a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.
•	Role could also be available in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane

Fetch Personnel are an Australian owned recruitment company with 10 years’ experience specialising in Contract and Labour Hire across Commercial, Industrial and Residential Construction, plus major Civil Infrastructure Projects throughout Australia. 
 
 THE OPPORTUNITY  
 
Due to internal promotions and high client demand we are looking to add  2 Consultants  to our established  Labour Hire  team, which has grown to become one of the leading divisions here at Fetch. 
 
Demonstrated minimum of two years recruitment experience and/or equivalent qualifications are required as you will be managing a  Warm/Live  360 desk within either the  Construction  or  Civil Infrastructure  industry. 
 
We are a proven industry leader in our chosen fields, with have a large database of candidates, clients, with live jobs to work on from day 1. 
 
Key responsibilities include but not limited to: 

 
	 Manage recruitment process from start to finish for both Client and Candidate. 
	 Utilising various candidate sourcing strategies to successfully attract applicants. 
	 Qualify candidate suitability and client commitment for current or future vacancies. 
	 Maintain and develop current client relationships 
 

  
We are looking for people who are career driven, resilient and have good business acumen. A natural engaging approach, strong written and verbal communication skills are a must. If you are looking to drive your own business but want the support to achieve this, then this is the opportunity you have been waiting for. 
 
 OUR CULTURE:  
 
Fetch are proud to have one of the best staff retention rates within the Recruitment industry. 
 
Everyone is treated with respect and given autonomy to run their own desk, alongside experienced management who provide hands on mentoring plus assist with long standing relationships to help you achieve success 
 
We love to celebrate success and have a huge focus on our culture: 

 
	 Work alongside Industry leaders within the Construction, Engineering, Infrastructure and Labour Hire recruitment 
	 Working from home arrangements 
	 26 days annual leave 
	 High achievers club 
	 Team building & Awards every quarter 
	 Networking functions 
	 Yearly team trips away 
	 End of month drinks 
	 New office complete with a barista style coffee machine, a table tennis table and library.

About Upgrade Health

Upgrade Health employs dedicated allied health professionals from around the World, who focus on physiotherapy, occupational therapy, podiatry, speech pathology, psychology, remedial massage, and pilates.  We also specialise in occupational rehabilitation including workplace assessments, suitable duties programs, return to work plans and pre-employment assessments.

Commencing immediately.

Salary range: $80,000 - $110,000 + performance driven bonuses.

Reporting to the Director you will be responsible for providing our clients with care and taking accountability in their journey back to better health, while aligning yourself with our core Values; Care, Excellence, Collaboration, Growth.
Right now, Upgrade Health has a rare opportunity for an experienced Occupational Therapist to join our rapidly growing team.

As a qualified occupational therapist, you will assess, treat and prevent physical difficulties resulting from injury, illness, disability or ageing to improve movement and general wellbeing. In this role, you will have the opportunity to independently manage a varied caseload of NDIS Clients including Private Patients, DVA, Workcover & EPC Clients.

What we offer:
? An Employer/Employee Value Proposition like you never experienced
? Competitive salary and benefits package
? Ongoing professional learning and development including mentoring and coaching
? A diverse and inclusive work environment
? Career pathways and networking opportunities
? Organised 1:1’s, fortnightly teaching and journal clubs
? Fully equipped practices with pilates reformer, shock therapy, acupuncture, exercise physiology, massage therapy, computerised gait analysis, advanced posture screening software, OH&S training and rehabilitation, manual handling seminars

What you offer:
? Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Occupational Therapy
? AHPRA registration required
? At least 2 years’ experience as a registered Occupational Therapist with 1-year experience in private practice
? Understanding of the rights of people with a disability
? Current Valid Driver's License
?Current Working with Children Check or willingness to obtain one before commencement

result.description: Visa2land Pty Ltd  JKT is in search for an Engineering Technologist with a strong background in Electrical and Telecommunication systems. This role combines hands-on technical work with coordination and oversight of project activities, ensuring the successful delivery of network installation and upgrade projects across commercial and residential sites.   Benefits   Opportunity to grow into technical leadership or management roles.  Competitive remuneration based on experience and qualifications.  Exposure to cutting-edge telecommunication network and electrical technologies.  Dynamic, multidisciplinary team environment.    Task & responsibilities   Install and configure Optical Network Terminals (ONTs), routers, and related hardware at customer premises (residential and commercial).  Establish delivery and installation schedules for machines, switchgear, cables, and fittings in coordination with engineering and project teams.  Determine the type and arrangement of circuits, transformers, circuit-breakers, transmission lines, and other electrical equipment to meet operational needs.  Collaborate with cross-functional teams to test, troubleshoot, and validate electronic telecommunication networks and systems.  Diagnose and replace faulty electrical components and monitor ongoing site performance to ensure reliability.  Ensure all installations, configurations, and modifications comply with relevant electrical and telecommunications standards and regulations.  Liaise with field managers and area supervisors to obtain regular updates, resolve technical challenges, and align on project progress.  Promote and adhere to all Work Health and Safety (WHS) and environmental policies, maintaining a safe and sustainable workplace.  Apply new and existing technologies to enhance network infrastructure and service delivery across multiple deployment projects.  Use statistical tools and network performance tests such as PET, MLT, SELT, TDR, and PON Meter Tests, and conduct open/short circuit diagnostics.  Support project planning, task allocation, and timely project delivery within defined budgets and technical specifications.    Qualification & experience   Tertiary qualification in Electrical, Communications Engineering, or related field.  Strong knowledge of telecom systems, network infrastructure, and electrical design.  Excellent project coordination, communication, and teamwork skills.  Proficient in troubleshooting electrical and communication systems.  Knowledge of industry standards, WHS, and compliance practices.  Valid driver’s licence with ability to travel to project sites. ABOUT US  
 
Fetch Personnel are an Australian owned recruitment company with 10 years’ experience specialising in Contract and Labour Hire across Commercial, Industrial and Residential Construction, plus major Civil Infrastructure Projects throughout Australia. 
 
 THE OPPORTUNITY  
 
Due to internal promotions and high client demand we are looking to add  2 Consultants  to our established  Labour Hire  team, which has grown to become one of the leading divisions here at Fetch. 
 
Demonstrated minimum of two years recruitment experience and/or equivalent qualifications are required as you will be managing a  Warm/Live  360 desk within either the  Construction  or  Civil Infrastructure  industry. 
 
We are a proven industry leader in our chosen fields, with have a large database of candidates, clients, with live jobs to work on from day 1. 
 
Key responsibilities include but not limited to: 

 
	 Manage recruitment process from start to finish for both Client and Candidate. 
	 Utilising various candidate sourcing strategies to successfully attract applicants. 
	 Qualify candidate suitability and client commitment for current or future vacancies. 
	 Maintain and develop current client relationships 
 

  
We are looking for people who are career driven, resilient and have good business acumen. A natural engaging approach, strong written and verbal communication skills are a must. If you are looking to drive your own business but want the support to achieve this, then this is the opportunity you have been waiting for. 
 
 OUR CULTURE:  
 
Fetch are proud to have one of the best staff retention rates within the Recruitment industry. 
 
Everyone is treated with respect and given autonomy to run their own desk, alongside experienced management who provide hands on mentoring plus assist with long standing relationships to help you achieve success 
 
We love to celebrate success and have a huge focus on our culture: 

 
	 Work alongside Industry leaders within the Construction, Engineering, Infrastructure and Labour Hire recruitment 
	 Working from home arrangements 
	 26 days annual leave 
	 High achievers club 
	 Team building & Awards every quarter 
	 Networking functions 
	 Yearly team trips away 
	 End of month drinks 
	 New office complete with a barista style coffee machine, a table tennis table and library. 
 

  
Interested? Please apply below or call Dan Musto on 0455 337 866 for a confidential discussion.

Role: IBM webMethods Integration – Support Engineer

Skills:
•	Integration Platform: IBM webMethods 10.15
•	Components: Integration Server, B2B, BPMS, CAF, Broker, API Gateway, Active Transfer
•	Services: REST APIs, SOAP Web Services
•	Protocols: HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SFTP, JMS, SMB

•	Tools: Designer, My webMethods Server, Command Central
•	Version Control: Git
•	Operating Systems: Linux, Unix, Windows
•	Methodologies: Agile, Waterfall
•	Support: Production Support, Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
Roles & Responsibilities:
•	Maintain enterprise integration solutions using the webMethods platform (v10.15).
•	Support integrations using Integration Server, B2B, BPMS, CAF, and Broker.
•	Support API integrations using webMethods API Gateway.
•	Support file transfer solutions using webMethods Active Transfer.
•	Maintain B2B integrations with external trading partners using EDI/XML and secure communication protocols.
•	Maintain business workflows and process automation using webMethods BPMS.
•	Design and maintain CAF-based applications for business users.
•	Support message-driven integrations using webMethods Broker and troubleshoot message flow issues.
•	Develop REST and SOAP web services for enterprise system integration.
•	Design reusable services, shared frameworks, and integration components following best practices.
•	Perform API development, enhancements, deployment, and production support activities.
•	Monitor production integrations, investigate incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and implement permanent fixes.
•	Handle Level 2 and Level 3 production support, ensuring adherence to SLAs and minimizing business impact.
•	Work closely with business stakeholders, solution architects, infrastructure teams, database administrators, and external vendors to deliver integration solutions.
•	Participate in requirement analysis, effort estimation, technical design, development, testing, deployment, and post-production support.
•	Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards and integration best practices.
•	Support environment setup, application deployments, configuration management, and release activities.
•	Troubleshoot performance issues and optimize existing integration services.
•	Work extensively with Oracle databases, SQL, XML, JSON, XSLT, and various file transfer mechanisms.
•	Manage application incidents, service requests, problem tickets, and change requests using ITIL processes.
•	Prepare technical design documents, deployment guides, operational runbooks, and knowledge transfer documentation.
•	Coordinate with cross-functional teams during production releases and major incidents.
•	Provide on-call support and participate in planned maintenance and weekend deployment activities.

Domain Experience:
•	Utilities (Electricity Provider)
•	Enterprise Application Integration
•	Business Process Automation
•	B2B Partner Integration
•	Production Support & Application Maintenance

A Place to Call Home. A Network That Builds Your Future.

Newcastle and its surrounds, Port Macquarie, and Tamworth offer more than excellent employment opportunities, they provide outstanding places to live. From the picturesque coastlines of Newcastle and Port Macquarie to the inviting rural character of Tamworth, each location delivers a balanced lifestyle that is both relaxed and active, supported by a strong sense of community. These settings are well-suited to individuals, couples, and families seeking both professional growth and quality of life.

You will be part of a highly connected network of hospitals that are collaborative, education-focused, and committed to excellence in patient care and trainee development. Our Emergency Departments are growing not only in size, but in scope, providing opportunities beyond clinical service, including:

Research

Point-of-care ultrasound

Trauma care

Dedicated education terms

Simulation training

We are proud of our strong culture of learning, mentorship, and professionalism. Our mission is to develop trainees into not only outstanding emergency physicians, but also compassionate, well-rounded individuals who feel deeply connected to the communities they serve.

Where you will be working 

You will work across our dynamic Emergency Medicine Network, which includes:

John Hunter Hospital

The Maitland Hospital

Calvary Mater Newcastle

Belmont District Hospital

Tamworth Rural Referral Hospital

Port Macquarie Base Hospital

This network provides a rich mix of metropolitan and rural experience, as well as access to diverse specialty terms for ACEM trainees at all stages.

John Hunter Hospital, one of the busiest Emergency Departments in Australia, offers a high acuity setting with a focus on trauma and retrieval medicine. If your training pathway requires tertiary experience only, this can be fully supported within the network at John Hunter Hospital.

What you'll be doing

The primary purpose of a Stage 1 Emergency Medicine Trainee is to provide high-quality medical care, under appropriate supervision, to undifferentiated patients presenting to the Emergency Department.

Trainees are expected to work within the scope of their clinical experience and training, contributing to patient care in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment. Seeking senior support and input when required is a core part of safe, effective practice.

This position contributes to and supports progression through Stage 1 of the Australasian College for Emergency Medicine (ACEM) Training Program. Our Emergency Medicine Network is fully accredited for Stage 1 training by ACEM, offering a diverse and comprehensive experience that prepares trainees for career success.

We are proud of our educational outcomes, including excellent Primary and Fellowship Exam pass rates, Structured, high-quality ACEM curriculum delivery and exam preparation

Training Opportunities Across Our Network

Our trainees rotate through a rich mix of clinical placements, including:

Tertiary and metropolitan adult and paediatric Emergency Departments

Intensive Care Units

Anaesthetics

Qualifications and experience commensurate with the Essential Requirements for the role.

Demonstrated ability to work with appropriate independence, commensurate with a level of a Specialist Trainee, within a supervised complex clinical environment.

Demonstrated ability to work effectively as part of a multi-disciplinary team in the planning, delivery and coordination of patient care.

Demonstrated high level written and verbal communication skills and ability to communicate effectively and respectfully with patients, family members and others members of the health care team

Demonstrated good organisational and time management skills and ability to manage competing priorities in a complex environment.

Demonstrated commitment to quality improvement, patient safety and risk management.

Evidence of continuing professional development and commitment to self-education.

Previous experience in and willingness to deliver undergraduate and postgraduate medical education and training
